title: Override Record
description: Immutable record of a guide overriding a system-generated item. Never silently applied.

override_id.description: Unique id for this override event.

item_id.description: Id of the content item being overridden.

original_content.description: Exact text of the system-generated content before override.

replacement_content.description: Replacement text. null if action is 'remove'.

action.description: replace: substitute with replacement_content; remove: delete item; flag: mark for later review without changing.

reason.description: Free-text reason given by the guide. Required, never empty.

clinical_safety_flag.description: True if the guide explicitly cited a safety concern as the reason.
